Method: peer-relative EV/Revenue 1.3x and EV/EBITDA 9x on corrected pro-forma EV (~$600M vs screener $860M), blended 50/25/25 with historical multiple (1.5x rev) and acquisition value (2.0x rev). new_positions.variant_perception: Market misprices Bandwidth's enterprise value. Screeners include $225M in operating lease liabilities as debt, inflating EV by 35% and making the stock appear fairly valued when it is significantly undervalued on financial-debt EV. Secondary: 82% incremental gross margin on new cloud comm revenue means operating leverage is dramatically steeper than trailing margins suggest.

new_positions.kill_switch: Exit if: (1) BAND closes below $11.00 on weekly basis; (2) Q1 2026 cloud comm revenue growth decelerates below 5% YoY; (3) any insider sells >25% of remaining holdings outside 10b5-1 plan; (4) FTC escalates to formal enforcement action or fine exceeding $25M.
